2607.27404.title: ECG-InterpBench: Benchmarking the Interpretability of ECG Foundation Models with Matched-Scale Sparse Autoencoders
2607.27404.paper_summary: Existing benchmarks for electrocardiogram foundation models primarily evaluate downstream predictive performance, providing limited insight into whether their internal representations can be faithfully decomposed, clinically interpreted, or reproduced across independent analyses. We introduce ECG-InterpBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the interpretability of ECG foundation-model representations. ECG-InterpBench uses sparse autoencoders as standardized measurement instruments and matches their capacity across models to enable controlled comparisons. We evaluate six frozen ECG foundation models across five standardized encoder depths, five matched dictionary widths, and three random seeds, producing a 450-cell interpretability atlas comprising 75 exactly matched six-model comparison blocks. The benchmark evaluates complementary dimensions of representation interpretability, including sparse reconstruction fidelity, single-feature accessibility and coverage of 49 clinically meaningful ECG measurements, and cross-seed feature reproducibility. The evaluation further quantifies patient-sampling uncertainty, depth- and seed-dependent variation, and sensitivity to the sparsity parameterization. The benchmark reveals that ECG foundation models exhibit distinct interpretability profiles. A matched replication on MIMIC-IV-ECG confirms that reconstruction fidelity and clinical accessibility identify different leading models. The benchmark is accompanied by executable evaluation code, standardized manifests, cell-level metrics, and reproducibility audits. ECG-InterpBench complements performance-centered ECG benchmarks by providing a capacity-controlled and reproducible framework for comparing ECG foundation models across distinct dimensions of representation interpretability.
2607.27404.paper_summary_zh: 現有的心電圖基礎模型基準主要評估下游預測性能，對於其內部表示是否能夠忠實分解、臨床解釋或在獨立分析中重現提供的見解有限。<lb/>我們引入了ECG-InterpBench，這是一個旨在系統性評估心電圖基礎模型表示可解釋性的基準。<lb/>ECG-InterpBench使用稀疏自編碼器作為標準化測量工具，並在模型之間匹配其容量以便進行受控比較。<lb/>我們在五個標準化編碼器深度、五個匹配字典寬度和三個隨機種子上評估了六個凍結的心電圖基礎模型，產生了一個包含75個完全匹配的六模型比較區塊的450單元可解釋性圖譜。<lb/>該基準評估了表示可解釋性的互補維度，包括稀疏重建保真度、單特徵可及性和49個臨床意義的心電圖測量的覆蓋範圍，以及跨種子特徵重現性。<lb/>評估進一步量化了患者抽樣不確定性、深度和種子依賴的變異性，以及對稀疏性參數化的敏感性。<lb/>基準顯示心電圖基礎模型展現出不同的可解釋性特徵。<lb/>在MIMIC-IV-ECG上的匹配複製確認重建保真度和臨床可及性識別不同的主要模型。<lb/>該基準附帶可執行的評估代碼、標準化清單、單元級指標和重現性審核。<lb/>ECG-InterpBench通過提供一個容量控制和可重現的框架，以便在不同的表示可解釋性維度上比較心電圖基礎模型，補充了以性能為中心的心電圖基準。
